text:
بھلی پھرے گوار،
جے بارے بنھے رب دے۔
romanized:
Bhulli phiré gawar,
je baré bannhé Rabb de.
literal_en: The peasant is mistaken who would shut the gates of God's mercy
meaning_en: i.e., God can give rain at any time.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
